plumbing.name: TSBPE 22 TAC 367.2: 2018 UPC or 2018 IPC (with 2018 IRC), per local choice; applies where no local plumbing code. 2021 editions proposed Aug 2026.

elsewhere: No statewide residential building code: inside city limits the IRC (2012 baseline under Local Gov Code 214.212; most cities adopt 2021 or 2024 IRC), unincorporated areas none. Statewide energy code is the 2015 IECC/IRC Ch. 11; NEC 2023 statewide for licensed electrical work; Tier 1 coastal counties also use TDI windstorm rules.
notes: Checked 2026-10-17. Correction: the statewide residential energy code is 2015, not 2021. TDLR's Sept 2026 move to the 2024 IRC is for its air-conditioning contractor program only, not a statewide residential code.
